subject: general
question:
Given below are few statements and their respective codes in a particular language:

Horse are Cat – XYT

Cat is Blue – TMZ

Blue is Cloud – ZMS

Which of the given options will be the code for the following statement in that language:

Blue Cat is Cloud-?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Horse are Cat – XYT

Cat is Blue – TMZ

Blue is Cloud – ZMS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244d4f4c7ac7db488ab10b2f68996c11ce1d2b03f5ec60d5d316b397c70d633f.png] 

∴ Here, Blue Cat is Cloud is coded as 'ZTMS'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"ZTMS".**
